sources.title: Exact tagged repository question and Batch 0033 frozen boundary
Longest Consecutive deterministic JDK 21 validation against independent sorting oracle

claims.text: The repository source identifies the Longest Consecutive Sequence task as LeetCode 128 but does not preserve a Java signature, null behavior, mutation policy, exact integer bounds, or required data structure.
Under the explicit answer-side contract, the exact Java fixture uses a HashSet and expands only from values with no representable predecessor, while guarding int-boundary arithmetic.

The compiled JDK 21 fixture passes six fixed cases, null rejection, non-mutation checks, both int-boundary directions, and all 97,656 arrays of lengths 0..7 over {-2,-1,0,1,2} against an independent sorting oracle.
